nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Overnight Face Mask

avis.titre: My favorite nighttime skin care cream.
avis.texte: Thus cream goes on soft and creamy leaving my skin velvety smooth. This product is part of my go to night time skin care routine. Just feels so good and my skin never looked better.

avis.titre: I use as a daily night cream
avis.texte: This keeps my skin hydrated and looking fantastic. I am a long-time user of clinique because it is fragrance free.
Love this, feels great going on and wake up nice and smooth. I have extremely dry skin, lupus and cancer drugs adding to the problem, but this works wonderfully.
Love this product and it absorbs quick while hydrates at the same time. Doesn´t feel greasy nor you get breakouts.

I have used this for years. I am 45 years old with dry skin. I use it as my daytime moisturizer. Love that it is in a tube rather than a container open to air. I tried IT and other creams but always come back to this one.

avis.titre: This diminishes crepey skin under my eye & wrinkles
avis.texte: I put it on at night after a shower and also use it with the Moisture Surge spray under my makeup. I've stopped wearing foundation in summer.

avis.titre: This lotion makes my skin feel renewed
avis.texte: When I use it at night three or 4 times a week I feel that my skin feels softer, and hydrated. In the morning when I wake up I can see the work he did during the night. I wake up as if I had just done my skin care
I love this mask. It rescues my dry skin. I use to apply it overnight and I like that it is not greasy

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I feel it keeps me from wrinkling away. I know, it sounds funny but I feel it really helps. I'm seventy one years old and I hardly have any wrinkles. I feel the Clinique brand has really helped my skin. I've been using this for years.
I am a fan of this nightime moisturizer! I use it in the evening after my regular moisturizer and it has been great to help control the oil in my skin.
I switched to this moisturizer at night during the winter months. it is light, order free, non-greasy. absorbs quickly. does a great job in keeping your skin hydrated in these dry, cold climates.

avis.titre: I noticed a difference right away
avis.texte: I have sensitive, dry skin - so this is a game changer. It is comfortable to sleep in, so not greasy or damp. My face also feels clean in the morning instead of over hydrated, which can happen.

I've been using this product for years. It works great on darker skin. It's like an overnight mini facelift. I put it on before sleep, and wake up looking like a million bucks. LOVE LOVEIT! It's worth every penny plus a buck.

I have matured skin and noticed it becoming dryer, after trying some different things I decided to try a sample of this Clinique overnight moisture surge and let me tell you I was amazed. Living in the NORTHEAST makes keeping your skin moist a little difficult at times but l'm extremely happy with this product. It works as designed. Thanks ( it pays to try those samples)
I really like this product! It moisturizes the skin well and is comfortable to use.

I have used this for years on my face right before I go to bed. I am moisturized in the morning and it's not sticky and my skin is still plumped. I have given this moisturizer as a gift to several people, who have also enjoyed it.

avis.titre: Skin is so soft in the morning
avis.texte: I have used oils at night as my skin tends to dry. Received this as a sample, have used it several nights and I love it! Skin feels so soft, amazing product.

A very easy application every night does help your skin - I love this stuff. I use it every night religiously and it does make a difference. I will also add that you don't need a lot so the tube will last a long time. Highly recommend!

I was in a musical performance that required strong make-up that left my face severely dry. I tried several hydrating oils, lotions and facials and received minimal results until I found this! It's now in my regular rotation!
I received a sample of this and tried it right away. My skin felt so supple.
I use this mask every night during the winter months as skin can become dry quickly. It absorbs quickly and is a light consistency with no scent.

I've been using the the mositure surge cream for a few years in a daily basis and ots great. I have a very dry, dehydrated skin. I was hoping this woukd give me an extra boost of moisture but it doesn't do anything. Skin doesn't feel more plump or moisturised.
I received this as a sample and I was hooked. It moisturizer so well that I use it for a regular moisturizer and not just as an overnight mask. I highly recommend.
I have used the moisture surge overnight mask for several years. It make my skin soft, smooth and fresh when I wake up every morning. Can't stop. Highly recommend!
I actually love that this is thicker than other moisturizeds because it leaves my skin feeling hudrated overnight.

I was looking for something light and hydrating for overnight. This is not it. It doesn't soak in well and stays tacky until the morning. I don't feel it's actually hydrating my skin as much as creating the illusion that my skin is moist (only because this doesn't soak in or dry well). I'm also not thrilled about some of the ingredients. Several come from petrochemicals.
It's been some months that my skin feels dryer, no matter what I did it didn't work until I found this face mask and it was "problem solved".
I don't understand why it's called moisture surge. Your skin will feel like an old sponge right after using and in the morning. I'm 65 with drier skin; perhaps that's the issue?
I received a sample of this overnight mask in a Clinique gift-with-purchase. I used it and really liked it, so I now bought a full size container. Clinique's Moisture Surge products are great!
I have used this for years. I have dry skin and its my morning moisturizer. Recommend for those who have drier than average skin.
I gave this a try and I'm in love. I woke up with Dewey skin. I was amazed.
I use it every night! I have combo skin that gets too dry and get pimples but since adding it in after cleansing my face i haven't had any break outs! Keeps my skin hydrated without getting greasy!

avis.titre: Best face lotion for dry skin
avis.texte: Only product that leaves me with dewy skin in the morning. Fantastic!

avis.titre: Expensive but worth it for people with dry skin
avis.texte: I love this product and have been using it for 4 + years! Pros: - a little goes along way (usually buy 1 a year) - extremely hydrating would use in the morning and night but I found that the clinique moisture surge - great for people with dry skin and acne since it didnt break me out at all Cons - expensive: but if you buy clonique products you usually get samples and the product itself lasts a long time - wish there wasnt a twisty lid so it felt more sanitary when doing skincare

This is my favorite product. It goes on silky smooth and works like magic overnight to make my skin feel smooth and fabulous in the morning. I look forward to applying it every night because it feels so comfortable on my skin

NOT ONLY DOES THIS HAVE HARMFUL DYES IN IT (Red 4 & Yellow 5), BUT IT DOESN'T WORK! It's okay-ish whenever I put it on at night, but it doesn't help dryness at all. It only masks it and doesn't improve skin the next day. Whenever I would wash my face with warm water in the morning after wearing this to bed, there would be no difference compared to the day before; it would wash off, and I'd have the same dry skin. I've tried multiple times, with the same effect every time. Moisturizers should restore moisture, especially if they're a thick overnight mask like this one is. THIS IS NOT EFFECTIVE. No wonder they keep giving full sizes for free with purchase. ALSO: it has harmful dyes in it! Red 4 and Yellow 5. Why are these in a face lotion?!?! Further proof that Clinique has gone downhill in the past year or two.
Originally tried as a sample now purchasing the full size. Worked very well on my very dry skin.

avis.titre: Wake Up With Healthy and Refreshed Looking Skin
avis.texte: I like the consistency of this product and the way it goes on my face and feels. I put it on at night and wake up the next morning with my skin looking healthy, refreshed and feeling great to the touch.

I received this as a promotional offer with my Clinique order. I love other Clinique products. They are gentle and work well on my skin, but this one makes my eyes itchy and puffy. I even gave it a few tries in case that was in reaction to other products, but nope this one.
This overnight face mask is amazing! It makes my skin feels so soft when I wake up. I would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Not sure this product is quite for me
avis.texte: I like the product but it's just not giving me the moisture I need. At the price, I can't afford to buy anything different right now so I'll keep using it. But I've been using it for a couple of weeks now.
What!? I was shocked to see Red 4 and Yellow 5 as ingredients in this face lotion. Are you serious? I threw it away. Shame on you.
If you're looking for a way to revive dull, thirsty skin overnight, this mask is definitely worth trying!

Beware! This product is marketed as allergen free but it contains red 4 and yellow 5. Synthetic dyes can cause allergic reactions and can be absorbed into the skin. I'm disappointed to see so many Clinique products containing synthetic dyes. This one also contains wheat which IS an allergen and people with Celiac's cannot use. This is a huge no for me!!

This brand is marketed as clean and allergen friendly, so please be careful and read the ingredients!! Most of these products actually contain harmful toxic artificial dyes that can be absorbed into the skin. This one contains red 40 and yellow 5. These synthetic dyes can significantly increase your chances of having skin reactions. They also increase your risk of cancer and reproductive harm. Many also contain wheat in their ingredients, so if you have Celiacs it's not a safe option.

Use this nightly on top of all my other skincare. Highly recommend. Works for my sensitive acne prone skin. Will add a couple drops of oil if skin is very dry during the winter. Always have this on hand,
Seriously the best moisturizer ever! Doesn't make me break out and I even use it before makeup even though it says it's for overnight. Gives me the best glow!

avis.titre: Not like moisture surge but still good
avis.texte: It is a much more creamy, thick product and doesn't have that gel kind of feel like regular moisture surge. Instead of being rapidly absorbed it kinda sits on the skin. It does keep your face from drying out overnight but can have a stickier feeling than moisture surge, especially if you add too much. I like to use it on my hands and sometimes put moisture surge on before I use it on my face.

I received a sample size of this product as a free gift with purchase, and after a couple weeks of use, I honestly was so underwhelmed with it. I have a damaged moisture barrier causing irritated, dry, flaky skin around my chin, and sadly this mask did nothing to soothe it or provide extra hydration. Clinique's 72-hour lipid replenishing moisturizer worked much better for me, so I'll stick to that.

avis.titre: Nice product for most, but avoid if you have a wheat allergy
avis.texte: I don't know if the formula changed, or if I'm just more sensitive than I used to be. I loved this product for a nice treat of extra hydration at night sometimes, but then tonight my face turned red and on fire with it. I came on here to check the ingredients list, and it has wheat bran in it. If you don't have a wheat allergy, it's a nice product. I wish they wouldn't put wheat in so many products. I hope they will not put it in any of my go-to daily products, because I've been a life-long Clinique customer... and I don't want to have to go search for alternate products. My daughters are happy for the hand-me-down skincare, so it's definitely not going to waste... but I will miss you, Moisture Surge Mask! I will be happy to try you again if you stop having wheat. ;)
Silky skin! Winter time is coming up and I know it's time to bring out my large bottle. Some of the retinol products can cause a little more dryness, but this Moisture Surge Mask take all that away.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. My face was so dry and just within one day of using it I feel so much hydration in my face.
Ive used this every night for years. When I run out I immediately tell the difference in my skin.

avis.titre: Silky smooth skin in the AM
avis.texte: I love this product and highly reccomend! I use this after my cleanser with some Good molecules hylauronic serum underneath and by morning my skin is soft and supple. It has also dramatically reduced fine lines. Great product!! Get it.

I used to have uncontrollable combo skin until I took the time to find the right products. Dry, patchy, greasy… you name it and the wrong products would cause my eczema to flare up and why not throw a few pimples in there. This is one of the products I now regulalry use that has given my skin a healthy glow, balance, smoothness, less breakouts, and even soothes and helps to alleviate any eczema / dryness. I've purchased 3 times and will be getting another soon.
Having extremely sensitive skin I am always skeptical trying a new product. I have gone through a whole tube of this and absolutely love it.

I struggle with dry skin and dry patches year round. This product is amazing at supporting hydrated skin and helps me combat dry patches. I'm so impressed with this product, it has done more for me than any I've tried yet.

I tried this product on a whim and I'm so glad I did. From the very first application, my skin has just loved it. The feel is so luxurious and it gives the most deep moisturization. I apply it at the end of the day and it just makes me feel so relaxed and pampered.

avis.titre: Best night time moisturizer on the market!
avis.texte: This is an all-time favorite skincare product for me! I get immediate visible results overnight with each use. My skin soaks it in and plumps up, looking fresh and healthy the next day. This product gets me closer to that post-spa facial look than anything else I've ever tried (and I've sampled just about everything)! I use it occasionally over night, but you could use it every night. Occasionally if my skin gets a super dry patch in the winter time, I'll use a thin layer of it during the day. Immediate effectiveness!

I got this as a sample thinking I might like it a little. OMG! I love love this moisturizing face mask. I put it on at night when my face is dry, after dermaplaning face procedure,or just when my skin looks dehydrated. I am in love with this mask and will be a forever customer. Please don't get rid of it!
I have been using it every night for years! Never found snything the workd better for my dry skin! I love it.
I just used this product, overnight last night, and was amazed at the difference in my skin this morning. My face was smooth with wrinkles greatly diminished and a nice glow.

I love how this mask intensely hydrates and soothes without feeling heavy or greasy. The texture is so light, but the results are powerful! I love to use this after Even Better Clinical for zero irritation. It's perfection.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so soft!
avis.texte: This is my favorite moisturizer ever. It doesn't even feel like you're wearing a mask at night. It's light weight. I wake up to beautiful and soft skin. I would totally recommend.

I chose this mask for the free item with purchase deal and I wasn't planning on loving it as much as I do, I just wanted something fun and moisturizing to try. I have dry sensitive skin and use the redness line, which I love, but I seem to get dry areas that make applying my foundation difficult. One night is all it took for this stuff to work! I applied a thin layer like a do my moisturizer and by morning my dry patches were gone, and my skin was super soft. No breakouts, rashes or irritation…just smooth soft skin! I will warn you this stuff is kinda sticky but its well worth it since you wash it off right away in the morning.
Winter last 6 months were I live now, so I struggle to keep my skin healthy and moisturized, this has been a great help this year.

avis.titre: Do not use if you are celiac!
avis.texte: This product is not gluten free. Unfortunately, I did not realize this until a very painful and dry rash broke out around my eyes. This shouldn't be a problem for most people, but if you're celiac like me, I do not recommend.

I have been struggling with severely dry combination skin, so I tried this mask and it was amazing! My face was dewy until I wiped it off the next day and it didn't cause any unwanted reactions on my face. If anything it helped clear up what I already had.

I tried this for the first time after receiving it in a gift bag. At 9PM, I put this all over my face concentrating on my eczema rashes and extremely dry patches from retinization. I woke up at 3AM to my face smooth as butter. I couldn't believe it. I had to write this review instantly. I had been wearing the regular moisture surge to bed, but it didn't provide nearly as much moisture overnight as this did. Apparently aloe (which this product contains) helps with dryness from new retnoid treatment, so it makes sense why it helped me so much. I'll be adding this to my routine! Also, it was a little sticky at first but eventually settled into the skin really nicely.

I love this product! I have dry skin and this product provides much needed moisture to my skin. I use it at night. It refreshens and makes my skin glow by morning. I think that Clinique has a "keeper" here.

I have never regretted purchasing this moisture rich treatment. I live in CA and the fall is hot and dry. This is an overnight oasis for my face. I thank goodness I bought this...and I KEEP getting it.
I ordered this overnight mask a few times. I have a combination oily skin and this works. Absorb easily not remain my skin oily. Love it!

I use this creamy mask daily. It easily absorbs and makes skin feel very soft. I have used it alone but because I'm very dry I usually layer over moisturizer. It makes skin glow too. You should get this.
Omg this mask is everything! If you want hydrated and glowy skin , this is it! I use this faithfully every night! Skin is hydrated and smooth in the morning.
A Non Greasy Mask which leaves the skin very soft. Highly Recommend ! A life time product as a must.
What amazes me most about this product is how quickly it absorbs any red or improves any blemishes overnight. Faster than any product I've ever used before!

I've used Clinique products exclusively for decades, but I've never loved one so much as I love this Mask. Though using my regular night cream, I developed a painful patch of exema on a cheek. Tried OTC "cures." Tried dermatologist prescriptive cream. Neither worked. Out of my regular night cream, one night I used this as a night cream, which I'd wanted to try. The next morning my exema seemed better. In 4 days it was only a smooth pink spot, and in 10 days it was gone. Has never returned. Now I use both serum and this. It moisturizes like no other product I've used.
I have used Moisture Surge for decades and I think I always will! Great moisture alone or as a mask on top of your regular moisturizer.
It moisturize my skin well, good for overnight skin care, love it

I feel itchy, and I need to wash my face Normally, I love every single product from Clinic but this one is not for me. I have oily skin and I was in the sun yesterday, so maybe that has something to do with it

avis.titre: My Skin is Literally Glowing, Soft, well hydrated & refresh!
avis.texte: I LOVE this product. Even though it's an over night mask, I sometimes will use it during the day if my skin needs more of a thick cream to lock in moisture on days my skin decides to be dry that day. This is my absolute favorite product from clinique so far! I highly highly recommend this overnight moisture mask! It feels amazing with the feeling of stickiness. It glides on and soaks in! AMAZING!

I've used this every night for 5 weeks & as long as I'm able, I'll purchase this! It's the BEST moisturizer I've ever used, (next to Moisture Surge, which I use every morning) I am so glad I picked this as a "free gift", my skin feels amazing all day, even after wearing a mask at work for 10 hrs (job requirement). Its a 10/10 for sure!!

I love using this as an overnight moisturizer during winter months on my combo oily skin. A little goes a long way and it absorbs into my skin and keeps it moisturized while I sleep. It's too heavy for me use during the warmer months though so I just use the Moisture Surge Concentrate instead.
i just love every product of moisture surge and this one is my favourite!
Not greasy, very light scent (I prefer unselected) love this product, will definitely purchase again.

A great pick me up for when my skin is feeling tight or dry, usually after cleansing on a night. I have been using it on and off the last couple of weeks whenever my skin needs it. The creamy formulation has a peculiar 'plastic' smell which somewhat takes me aback until I remember "Ah it's Clinique, totally unscented...of course!". It has a slightly pearly sheen to it and absorbs into my skin fairly quickly, so on extra dry areas, I layer it on more thickly and let it sink in before getting into bed. For oily-dehydrated combination skin like mine, it can be tricky to find the right balance in a product. This is not too rich, and yet it's adequately moisturizing too, with both Shea Butter and Sodium Hyaluronate in it. The only issue I have with it is the 'Dimethicone' - too much of which can wreak havoc on my skin, as I noticed after years of diligently using their DDMG. Luckily for me I don't need to use this every night, only occasionally, and for that it ticks all the right boxes. -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Hair Loss Treatment: Divine Herbal Hair Oil < 2. Eye Cream: Clinique All about eyes < 3. Lip Gloss: Clarins Lip Comfort Oil < 4. Makeup Remover: Lancome Bi Facil < 5. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: Divine Herbal Facial Treatment Serum < 6. Eyeliner: Ulta Beauty Gel Eyeliner Pencil < 7. Moisturizer: 'Lush' – Enzymion

I received a trial version of this mask and now I will definitely buy it! Moisturizes the skin perfectly! I use it twice a week. I apply it at night before going to bed. In the morning, the skin is moisturized and shines.
I don't really review but this one has won my heart! My face looks so hydrated since I started using this. It does absorb instantly and moisturizes the skin throughout the night.

I have used Clinique off and on since my teens. From my oily young skin living in California, to my now aging 50 year old dry skin in New England. Recently picked up a philosophy overnight cream for $84 😫, wish I could return, it did nothing except give me little bumbs under my eyes. So back to the Clinique 3 step, and added this to my night time routine. My skin loves it. and it costs much less than other big brands.
I used many clinique products like Clinique Even Better Clinical Serum and Even Better concealer and many more there are perfect but this product makes my skin redness i don't know why :(

My 14 year old is a swimmer and has very dry skin and loves this mask! I was experiencing dryness from starting a retinol serum and took her advice to try this and it works very well! I do reapply a couple of times if the dryness is really bothering me. I love the way it makes my skin glowy and soft.
This product accentuated the redness and larger pores on my face. It also felt greasy and heavy, like having an ointment on the face.
My skin looks so much better when I get up. Makes a big difference.

avis.titre: Not for everyone! May cause acne-like bumps!
avis.texte: Clinique is great and most of their products will work for many skin types. This is not one for everyone! It goes on nicely and feels fine but by morning I looked like a teenager again. Red bumps on my cheeks and forehead that took a few day to go away. This one is definitely not right for me.
This is my favorite face care ever. I use it every night, almost last 6 years. I have very sensitive and alergic skin and I only trust Clinique products
My face isn't dry all year round, but I like to use this when I've had too much sun or when the weather snaps from warm to cold. Gets it back to normal.

I tried this out from a sample and it's very different from their gel moisturizer. It's a very thick, sticky product. I did this overnight and while the rest of my face does feel moisturized, the lily spots I do have are extra oily. My skin has a LOVELY glow to it but my nose area just can't take this pulse I'm breaking out in just one use while the gel never does this for me. It may be for dry skin folks, but my comb skin isn't a fan.

avis.titre: The cooling hydration of the moisturizer amped up
avis.texte: This has the very dreamy nighttime moisturizer heaviness I love in masks but still has that signature gel-like cooling feeling and moderate but instantly recognizable fragrance of the moisturizer. This really kept my skin calm and pillowy soft after 6 hours of sleep and travelling with delays by plane all day and worked without issue alongside all my actives in previous steps in my routine as well. My skin usually feels like it's dried out even with using my more occlusive moisturizers and one of my face oils after a flight journey, but this held up for over 13 hours and kept my skin feeling soft and not tight at all. I used to like the moisture surge moisturizer but found my skin dried out too quickly for it to be used only once a day, this is a perfect upgrade for me and I am very happy I can enjoy the experience of the cooling moisture in this more heavy duty formula.
I have very dry sensitive skin and this has helped so much! I also love to use a little to moisturize under my make-up.

I got this for free when I purchased a Christmas gift (yeah, I kept it!). It had been a long time since I used the Clinique system, my skin has matured since, I had been using the acne/oily skin level. Apparently I chose the wrong products because my skin LOVES the moisture surge plus this moisture surge mask. My forehead and cheeks were constantly flaky, and honestly I was just using drugstore face cream after washing with unscented liquid castile soap (it worked a while). I am back on board with the dry/very dry level products and things are going great for my dry, sensitive, reactive, very picky face skin!

avis.titre: wonderful solution for extremely dry skin
avis.texte: I tried a sample of this product. I have extremely dry skin. The only solution that I found was putting petroleum jelly on. However, when the weather gets colder and drier during winter, even petroleum jelly is not enough to protect my skin from dryness. Putting on moisturizer under the petroleum jelly made it a little bit better, but still not fully comfortable. At this time, I coincidently had a chance to try this product. I put it on the bare skin and then put on petroleum jelly. After 4 hours I could feel amazingly comfortable feeling of fully hydrated watery skin. It is like magic. I will definitely buy this continuously. I hope this product last forever.

I always suffer from dry, red skin in the winter and haven't been able to find anything that hydrates well enough. I received a sample of this product so tried it. It has helped so much with my dry skin! I'm going to order it as I'm impressed with how well it hydrates overnight.

I've used the moisture surge face cream for 10+ years and recently tried this product out. In my opinion, this really doesn't do anything for hydration. Maybe it's to be used over a different moisturizer than the moisture surge. I feel like if you are already using a good quality moisturizer, then this is not necessary.
I'm on my third tube. Really goes on smooth. I use on face and neck. Really works!
I keep getting this as either a sample or as part of a gift set. It's okay if it's what your skin needs, but I guess I really don't need it because it didn't do much for me.
I love using this a couple of nights a week. When my skin is looking and feeling dry.

I got this as a sample. I used it twice and both times my face was extremely sticky. Thank goodness I didn't waste any money on this product. I will stick with the dramatically different moisturizing gel.
I love it! I purchased it on January 2022, I have used it every night and have a fresh and smooth face in the morning with a fully moisturized face! Although it is a little bit pricy, It is worth it.

I'm new to skincare, and so I purchased a few holiday sets to try out lots of products and see what works best. When I tell you, this is the most incredible product I've ever tried, I'm not exaggerating. I had problems with all the other night creams I tried that they made me feel very sticky and it was uncomfortable when trying to sleep. Putting this overnight mask on feels so luxurious on my skin and does not give me the sticky feeling. I wake up and my skin is still moisturized, and when I wash my face in the morning, my skin is so smooth. I pair this with the Clinique lip hydro-plump treatment for my nighttime lip mask and it is heaven. Seriously my new holy grail skincare product. I already purchased a backup so when my current bottle runs out, I won't have to go a single night without it.

I initially got a travel size as I just needed something for a trip and thought it would help with dry air plane air. It was fantastic and so I started buying full sizes. Use daily. Way better than the traditional yellow lotion they make.

I wake up every morning with a fully moisturized face. When I wash my face in the morning I still feel all the moisture! My skin feels like anew and I use this every night! This is worth every penny :)
My skin dries out esp in winter. As soon as I put this on, it feels like a wonderful drink of water for my thirsty skin. I literally can't live without it.

I have super dry skin. I thought an overnight mask would help with the flaky skin that I have in the morning. This mask did nothing. It's described as being for All Skin Types. I guess my skin is an exception!

I used this product for 3 years religiously. During that time, it was the only thing that kept my face moisturized in the winter. Unfortunately, my dermatologist urged me to discontinue use after developing perioral dermatitis. This condition is typically associated with steroid creams, and this formula contains phytosterols, a steroid-alcohol. If you have sensitive skin, or are prone to dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, etc., I would skip this one.

The title says it all - this is hands down my favorite moisturizer. I reach for it more often than the others I have because it works so well. It feels really smooth and soothing when applied and makes my skin super soft by the morning. Please keep making this and I will keep buying it forever!

avis.titre: My Face Looks and Feels Amazing!
avis.texte: After washing my face with the Clinique All-About-Clean Extra Mild Facial Soap and using my Finishing Touch Flawless Facial Cleaser, I apply this mask and leave it on overnight. I wake up every morning with a clearer and softer complexion.

avis.titre: Best night cream I've ever tried
avis.texte: I absolutely love this mask...I use it every single night and in the morning my skin is so soft. I have very sensitive skin and this is amazing with no allergic reactions.

This is my go-to mask for winter (and occasionally other times of the year). My skin is very dry so I slather this on my face before bed, top with rose hip seed oil and I wake up with a soft silky face in the morning. I love this stuff!
I received this as a sample when I bought something from clinique.com and loved it. It kept my face very hydrated. I woke up and saw that my skin was very soft.
I have sensitive, breakout prone skin. This is the best thick n creamy moisturizer I've tried. It feels like a non oil-free moisturizer. I use this for both day and night.

I'm kinda confused on how this works. I applied it and left it on overnight, but I didn't really do anything. I just feel like I wasted money to be honest. I noticed a lot of people were dry skin I said it worked. but I have oily skin so maybe that's why it didn't work
I loveeeeeee this mask! You notice the difference the first time you use it 👏🏼👏🏼

This cream is quite reach and soothing, doesn't have any specific smell and as an allergic person who struggles to find moistrising product that my skin won't reject, I'd say this is it. It plumps and moisturises skin visibly after one use. No sticky or heavy feeling either, like you usually (or in my case anyway) would get with overnight masks. I'd say this is the second best moisturising product after Moisture Surge 72h.

I use this as a moisturizer at night and my skin loves it! The next morning my skin feels soooo soft. I have oily skin but that doesn't mean mean my skin is hydrated well. This really helps keep it soft. You can get away with using this in the day time especially if you have dry skin. But I just use it at night.

avis.titre: My skin looks amazing after use
avis.texte: I use this mask 1-2 times a week over night. Especially when I feel like my skin is a bit dry. Afterwards my skin realy glows and feels very nourished. This mask absorbs very fast and does not leave annoying residue on skin. Will keep buying this!

avis.titre: Nightly use and I love it
avis.texte: I started using this when I got some as a sample... and now I can't go to bed without it and willingly pay full price for it. I use it nightly, and it leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth. Fewer wrinkles noted, and I actually look forward to my night-time skin routine because it feels great going on.
My skin is currently dried out from acne treatments and the Moisture Surge Overnight Mask has made a huge improvement in the way my skin feels and looks.
Love this product- love this product even more after my full evening routine. Feels like butter and doesn't make me break out.

Fantastic! Even though this is a mask I use it nightly over my eye cream and serums during the drier winter months and a couple nights a week during the summer/warmer months. Its sooo moisturizing but not overly thick to apply, smooths on really well and leaves skin feeling plump and hydrated.

This product is wonderful! Every time when I use it at night, I can see the improvement of my skin the next morning. My skin stays hydrated and feels relaxed. The pinkish color makes it even more lovely. Great product!
I have very dry skin and I've been using this mask for about a year now. It has seriously changed my skin! I'll never go back

I rarely need to use this on my face as I have extremely oily facial skin, but I tried it on my arms and legs where my skin was ridiculously and constantly dry and flaky. I was always applying lotion and it never really helped but for a few minutes. I put this mask on my arms and legs ONE time and it fixed the issue! I'm going to always have this on hand in case it happens again!
I love this mask. It works overnight, then my face is deeply moisturized and refreshed the next morning.
Avoid this if you are sensitive to mango (or poison ivy or poison oak); this product can cause a serious allergic rash!
This mask is so moisturizing, I don't skip a night without it. This is definitely a must have!

I like to add this onto my skin after my other moisturizers and serums. At night I'll add a little bit more than I would in the morning. If you put it on for the daytime, you can put on sunscreen over it without any problems.
I love this mask because you can leave it on overnight. My face feels smooth and refreshed in the morning. It isn't greasy, seems to soak into my skin

I use the Moisture Surge Overnight Mask everyday! For my face, it adds and locks in moisture and I wake up with visibly calmed, visibly glowing skin. Not only do I apply it to my face after all of my other skincare steps at night, but I also use it on my hands, and since I have I no longer get cracks on my fingers. I even use it on super dry patches of my arms and legs during winter -- small amounts go a long way and really soothe my skin.

avis.titre: Would not purchase this product again
avis.texte: Although it feels great on your skin, I don't feel it does anything more than the very cheap products.
I love this product. This product makes my skin feel hydrated and not greasy.

I use this almost every night after removing makeup and washing my face with a warm washcloth. I wake up with refreshed and soft skin. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this product does not agitate my skin.

I received this as a gift. I love Clinique's smart line of products. I'm on my 2nd jar of the eye cream. I use this mask at night, after I take off my makeup, apply eye cream& face serum. It locks all of the good ingredients in for the night. My face the next morning is glowing, dewy,& feels super soft! I jrinse it off in am with warm water. Great & Consistant line of products; Great Work Clinique!!!

I really like this product. I use the regular moisture surge moisturizer during the day and apply a thin layer of this at night. I have oily acne prone skin so I don't apply a large amount of this at night. Just enough to cover my face and soak in, without any extra. I wanted something that was a little richer than my daytime moisturizer. Works great!

I was hesitant about buying it since I have very sensitive skin prone to allergic reaction to all cosmetics except most mild. But my skin became very dry and I wanted to do something about it, so despite the negative reviews about it causing breakdowns and/or having no-effect and also with no trial version available, only full-size for almost $40, I decided to try it. Well, it worked just fine. I applied after the 3-step in the evening. I did in fact have a little tingling sensation on my face after applying and was a bit afraid that I'll be soon all red and itchy, but it stopped in a minute with no visible consequences. The skin of my face was still a liiitttleee bit sticky in the morning BUT it did not feel dry, it looked fresh, well-rested and had that little healthy glow - just perfect! So, only 4 stars (in fact, should be _almost 5_ - like, 4.8-4.9) because of that tingling and stickiness, but the effect is exactly the one I was hoping for. Also - I'd probably tried this product earlier were the trial- or travel-size version available in addition to the full-size product

Many night creams are too thick and leave me looking greasy the next morning. I tried a sample tube of this, and it's perfect for my oily/combo skin. When I wake up my skin looks well-hydrated and healthy, not greasy. Best night cream I've used!

avis.titre: With the right routine- life changing
avis.texte: Obviously it won't soak in and hydrate as well without a proper skin care routine done before hand but this is the best over night moisturizer that I use and it only takes a little bit!

avis.titre: An End to My Dry Skin
avis.texte: This overnight mask has saved my skin. My face was so dry this past winter that it was painful. I started using this every night and all day on my days home and it was such a comfort to me.
Feels moisturizing going on but honestly CeraVe works better and my skin feels more soft and plump the next day with drugstore moisturizer.

This is an amazing product! I recently moved to an area where the humidity is extremely low. As I had always lived in a high humidity area (Gulf Coast), I was not prepared for the havoc the lower humidity would play on my skin & skincare! Wow, what a learning curve! Clinique's Moisture Surge to the rescue! As I have a tendency to break out, I needed to stay with oil-free products. I decided to try Clinique's Moisture Surge line of products. I can honestly say, these products have changed my life!!! This overnight mask is the last product I put on at night. I wake up with soft, smooth, plumped, and comfortable skin! Always a a winner & always a reliable product. A little goes a long way, and also a very economical product.

avis.titre: I wake up with the best skin!
avis.texte: Mu skin feels sooo hydrated in the mornings! No more stiff face when I wake up. I adore it!

I use this as a moisturizer in the cold winter when the heater is blasting. I live in the NW and it can be trying sometimes. I found this overnight mask less oily and sticky than other winter moisturizers in department stores. It is also inexpensive for the amount you get. A frequent re-stock for me.
This mask didn't make my skin glow like what others said, but it definitely keep my skin moist all night thats for sure. The texture is a bit sticky.
Just what my skin needs for total hydration. Glad that it cones in this size, too.
I received this as a gift and I love the way I can just put it on before bed and skin feels amazing in the morning.

I got this as a free gift with purchase. I wouldn't normally have picked it but I'm sure glad I got it! It really works. I put it on my face and neck and I woke up with super soft skin!!! I put it on my hands too. I don't usually use a thick night cream so I can't compare - but might be similar if you use one.
This feels so good on my very dry skin. I wish I had tried it sooner!

avis.titre: Brings aging skin to dewy overnight
avis.texte: This was a free full sized sample I received with a purchase. I have only used it in the late fall and winter months so far. Having recently realized the necessity of moisturizing my 47 year old face to help me look younger, I make sure to use a really moisturizing product while I sleep. I ran out of the product that I had been using, and gave this freebie a try. It is awesome. I woke up with my face looking looking more plump and dewy as opposed to line-filled and drawn. I continued to use it every night, until it was gone. I went without it for a few weeks and realized the difference! Nothing I've used on my skin at night is as good. I am now starting my second tube, which I gladly purchased. I highly srecommend this!

I had extremely dry skin to the point where my skin was flaking off in chunks. One of the workers at Ulta recommended this and after one try my skin was better! Completely recommend this for super dry skin

This overnight mask arrived as a sample & had been sitting on my vanity for some time before I picked it up & used it one morning--before putting in my contacts & realizing I had grabbed the overnight product first thing after a shower... Wonderful "mistake" for my winter-weary overly dry & worn out winter skin. This quickly became my winter facial rehydration every morning the weather hovered below freezing! It absorbed quicker than I expected & leaves my face feeling fresh & soft all day long!
This product was ok but I feel I have other items from Clinique that achieve the same result. A bit heavy for combo skin. I do reach for it when the winter weather drys my skin excessively.

I received this as a free sample and I am definitely adding as part of my skin care routine! I love how it feels on my skin Thank You Clinique for never disappointing can't wait to purchase more products
Winter is hard on aging skin. Using this mask helps retain moisture overnight & wake up with soft skin. A regular in my regiment!

I'm in my mid 60s and when I get up in the morning my skin looks and feels so much younger. There's no heavy feeling when I apply it, it absorbs quickly and my skin is so soft. Wonderful product and I couldn't do without it!
I love using this product. It makes my skin so soft and dewy when I wake up in the morning
I have *SUPER* dry skin year round, but especially in the winter and colder months. I have replaced my normal moisturizer with this and it works AH-MAZING as a teice-daily moisturizer!

Being in my 50's, I am trying to stave off impending wrinkles, but I still have acne. I was worried that a product such as this, even though it is "oil free", would surge the moisturizing straight into the acne zone. This product was included in a gift set I purchased, so I decided to try it. I am so glad I did! It does not feel greasy at all, and it absorbs well. The next morning, I was just amazed with how soft my skin felt. Also, with my skin having adequate moisture, the concealer I use to hide the my couple of pimples and blackheads, was easier to apply, and l was able to blend it in properly, with a much more natural effect than I usually get. Importantly, I have not had any increased acne or breakouts using this. Another Clinique product I am now hooked on!

New York City winters are harsh on my skin and incredibly drying. I was lucky enough to be introduced to this by a Clinique skin care specialist and am so thankful. I use it morning and night and boy does it quench my parched skin.

avis.titre: Hydrated skin well but chin broke out when using
avis.texte: I've used this product 3 times so far. The next morning my skin looks really hydrated but unfortunately my chin has broken out each time. I'm going to try to keep using but not on my chin and see how it goes. It's pretty thick too

I tend to have super dry skin i use this with a couple other products at night i wake up and my skin is so amazing!!!! I no longer have red patchy dry skin its smooth and even and the amount of product they give u is shocking! Its a huge amount definitely try this if u are struggling with dry skin

This moisturizer goes on very smoothly with no oily or greasy feel. I was amazed from the first night I used it. Any time I wake up during the night, as well as in the morning, my face feels soft and hydrated, without feeling damp. I will definitely be buying more and using this on a regular basis.

This is a wonderful mask that brings much needed relief to my dry skin. I swim almost daily so my skin gets dried out from constant exposure to chlorine. After I've showered following my swim, I put on the mask and let it work it's magic overnight! Love it!

Had a free sample in with my order - totally thrilled so lovely and silky to use and results were perfect. Will definitely be on my list to buy.Put it on top of my Smart clinical repair wrinkle correcting serum. Really worked so perfect together fabulous.
Can't say how it makes your skin. For personal experience only I would say please try it and you shall see the results.
My skin was getting so dry like leather and in two nights with this on I feel brand new. Honestly is the best

I initially received this as a sample, and it sat in the drawer for a while before I used it. Once I tried it, I was hooked. During the winter months my skin craves this rich formula. I use it every night. I wake up with brighter, hydrated skin.
Wonderful product for nighttime use. Hydration and soft in morning. There are times I leave it on all day. Skin is soft and smooth.
Doesn't moisturize well. I feel like this is one of the worst and useless product from clinique.

avis.titre: Best Moisturizer to use with tretinoin
avis.texte: This works great to keep my face from drying out while using tretinoin! Thank you for the sample, now it is a must purchase!
